output.summary: The group-wide 17-18 minute ticket time began in October 2024 in all nine locations at once. It matches the board-approved, projected and knowingly accepted scratch menu, and it sits under the 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction and food quality rose, sales and checks outperformed the segment, and the benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens. The data show no group-wide inefficiency. Riverside's rise from August 2026 is local. It tracks the saute/pasta cook's departure, an unfilled position and deferred transfers, and the station data are consistent with that. Why the cook left is disputed, so the evidence does not support replacing the GM. Frozen standardization and a 12-minute bonus are harmful; the earlier ticket-time bonus led to gaming. Restore Riverside staffing and reset the benchmark.
